body.objective: Repair the exact historical-base/current-path binding conflict exposed by the post-extension Observer Tier-3 traversal without changing either legacy receiver disposition or creating a recursive content-address dependency.
body.stop_condition: Import OBSERVER_TIER3_FIXED_POINT_AFTER_LEGACY_CROSSWALK_EXTENSION_V2_OBSTRUCTION and the terminal seven-row CHARGED_TIME_RECEIVER_ADMISSIBILITY_CROSSWALK_V1 by exact hashes. Make both legacy rails—BERGER_LEGACY_RECEIVER_ADMISSIBILITY_REPLAY_V1 and BERGER_LEGACY_RECEIVER_OPERATIONAL_FREQUENCY_RATIO_NONACTIVATION_V1—resolve the exact historical five-row receiver-contract blob by immutable source commit, repository-relative path and SHA-256 instead of assuming that blob remains at the mutable current crosswalk path. Independently verify the commit exists, the named blob is a regular Git blob with the declared hash, and its five scientific dispositions match the historical contract. Regenerate both legacy certificates, then regenerate and independently verify the seven-row crosswalk against the new legacy certificate hashes. Prove that both legacy rows remain NO_CERTIFIED_MAP, the operational frequency-ratio domain remains empty, coordinate ratio one remains non-redshift, all original five rows remain unchanged, and no current-contract-to-legacy-to-current-contract cycle exists. Audit the direct atlas/crosswalk consumers and fail closed at the first additional stale pin rather than broad relocking. Add mutations for wrong commit, wrong historical path, wrong blob hash, current-path substitution, deleted legacy row and attempted redshift promotion. Export exact certificates, receipts, reports and atlas dispositions with dependency tags and content hashes.
body.current_gate: historical five-row base resolution for the two legacy Observer rails without a recursive current-crosswalk dependency
body.forbid: no direct relock of either legacy rail to the mutable seven-row current crosswalk; no current crosswalk imported as a dependency of a legacy certificate that the current crosswalk itself imports; no change to either NO_CERTIFIED_MAP disposition; no coordinate ratio called redshift; no producer rerun called independent verification; no broad corpus relock beyond the two legacy rails and their direct typed consumers; no Paper 9, detector, nonlinear, particle or quantum promotion
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER PHASE-1 PROVENANCE REPAIR. This is an immutable historical-blob resolution problem, not a new receiver calculation. Preserve all seven scientific dispositions and stop on the first downstream pin outside the direct consumer set.
notes: The failed Tier-3 run passed 398 tests before exposing this binding conflict. The seven-row crosswalk itself is correct.

A direct hash update is forbidden because the legacy certificates are extension sources of the current crosswalk; the repair must break the cycle by addressing the historical base blob independently of the current path.
